name: kitsuvo
description: Browse and inspect websites using your installed Kitsuvo browser.
long_description: Requires Kitsuvo installed on Windows or macOS. Uses a separate automation profile and refuses sensitive pages by default. Page content returned through MCP is visible to your connected AI client. No cloud relay is enabled by this extension.

kitsuvo_binary.title: Kitsuvo executable
kitsuvo_binary.description: Use kitsuvo when it is on PATH, or the full path to the installed executable. On Mac: /Applications/Kitsuvo.app/Contents/MacOS/kitsuvo.
